content.value: Write down a C program that can take any year as input from the user , as many  0 times as the user wants. Then it determines a prints out whether that is a leap year or not. Rules for determining leap year:
(i) The year must be divisible by 4 but shouldn't be divisible by 100. OR
(ii) The year has to be fully divided by 400.
